note: Fetched, hashed, and NOT committed: the issues lists carry their submitters' and the committee's own words under no general redistribution licence (precedent: works/2026-10-14-whose-account/sources/MANIFEST.json). This work quotes within citation length and commits issue numbers, codes and derived counts. The lists are revised at every committee meeting; a later fetch will differ, and the numbers in order.json fix the sample.

sources.what: C++ Standard Core Language Closed Issues (WG21 Core Working Group, list dated 2026-10-11, reference ISO/IEC 14882:2024): 516 issues, 408 of them with status NAD (not a defect).
sources.why: S127.DECLINE requires a public register of corrections that is neither this repository's nor the RFC Editor's, that records refusals, named before the readers run. NAD is this register's refusal.

sources.what: C++ Standard Core Language Defect Reports and Accepted Issues, same list date: 2,179 issues parsed, each accepted with a resolution adopted into a working draft or standard (statuses TC1, CD1 to CD7, C++11 to C++26).
sources.why: The accepted issues are mixed into the readers' file so that a refusal is not the only outcome they see, as Whose Account mixed Verified with Rejected.
